name: com.com2usplatform.hiveaxyl.payments.addon.apple
displayName: Hive Axyl Payments Addon - Apple StoreKit
description: Apple StoreKit2 in-app purchase addon for Hive Axyl SDK. Wraps Product / Transaction / AppStore to expose raw StoreKit2 product, purchase, and transaction fields (including the signed JWS) on iOS 17.0+ and macOS 15.0+.
